title: The corridor
hints: You need four instructions in total, one on each line.
Remember to put your object, a dot, and the method with empty brackets on each line.
intro: The gate will not open for us yet, so let's look around the garden! Write a program to walk down along the path, then around the corner to the left.
outro: Well done! You used different methods to turn the corner. Look, I found a program I wrote earlier!
learned: Now you know what objects and methods are, and the four moves.
